title: SendGrid keys inside Markdown code spans
summary: The SendGrid key shape inside backticks after the words SendGrid credential:, in base62, URL-safe and trailing-dash forms.
rationale: A report that spans the closing backtick redacts documentation text, and one that omits the trailing character leaves part of the key visible; a trailing dash right before the backtick is the edge case.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The key is in the documented format; the range excludes the backticks and includes the last character.
